call.homer.0__hot.text: He CRUSHES it — high, deep, and GONE, into left field!
call.homer.0__hot.speaker: announcer

call.homer.0__lift.text: He CRUSHES it — high, deep, and GONE, into left field!
call.homer.0__lift.speaker: announcer

call.homer.1__hot.text: He got every bit of that one! Say goodbye — it is out of here, into right field!
call.homer.1__hot.speaker: announcer

call.k-looking.0__hot.text: Called strike three, on the outside corner! He's out looking.
call.k-looking.0__hot.speaker: announcer

call.k-looking.0__lift.text: Called strike three, on the outside corner! He's out looking.
call.k-looking.0__lift.speaker: announcer

call.k-swinging.0__hot.text: He swings through it! Strike three, and he's gone.
call.k-swinging.0__hot.speaker: announcer

call.k-swinging.0__lift.text: Swing and a miss — that's the punchout!
call.k-swinging.0__lift.speaker: announcer

call.walk.0__calm.text: Outside — ball four. He drops the bat and takes his base.
call.walk.0__calm.speaker: announcer

call.walk.0__lift.text: That's ball four, and he'll walk down to first.
call.walk.0__lift.speaker: announcer

call.single.0__calm.text: A base hit into left field, and he's aboard.
call.single.0__calm.speaker: announcer

call.single.0__lift.text: Lined into right field for a base knock.
call.single.0__lift.speaker: announcer

call.double.0__lift.text: Laced into the gap, and he pulls in standing with a double!
call.double.0__lift.speaker: announcer

call.double.0__hot.text: Off the wall in left-center! He'll have two.
call.double.0__hot.speaker: announcer

call.groundout.0__calm.text: Chopped into the infield — the throw across, and they get him.
call.groundout.0__calm.speaker: announcer

call.groundout.0__wry.text: Grounded to short, and it's a routine play.
call.groundout.0__wry.speaker: announcer

gameover.walkoff.0__hot.text: HE WINS IT! They walk it off — ballgame!
gameover.walkoff.0__hot.speaker: announcer

color.chase.0__wry.text: He chased that one. That was nowhere near the plate.
color.chase.0__wry.speaker: color

color.barrel.0__lift.text: That is what a barrel sounds like.
color.barrel.0__lift.speaker: color

color.tension.0__lift.text: You can feel the tension in the building right now.
color.tension.0__lift.speaker: color

color.taken-cookie.0__wry.text: He can't take that pitch. Right down Broadway.
color.taken-cookie.0__wry.speaker: color
